description: Utility functions for distributed training, tensor handling, and metrics in object detection projects, including classes like SmoothedValue and MetricLogger, and functions for distributed setup, tensor operations, and accuracy computation.

classes.name: SmoothedValue
classes.description: Tracks a series of values and provides smoothed statistics like median, average, global average, max, and current value.

classes.name: MetricLogger
classes.description: Logs and manages multiple SmoothedValue meters, supports updating, string representation, synchronization, and logging during training.

classes.name: NestedTensor
classes.description: Encapsulates a tensor and an optional mask, supports device transfer and decomposition.

methods.name: all_gather
methods.description: Gathers arbitrary picklable data from all processes into a list.

methods.name: reduce_dict
methods.description: Reduces a dictionary of tensors across processes, optionally averaging.

methods.name: get_sha
methods.description: Retrieves current git commit hash, diff status, and branch name.

methods.name: collate_fn
methods.description: Collates a batch of data, converting the first element into a NestedTensor.

methods.name: nested_tensor_from_tensor_list
methods.description: Creates a NestedTensor from a list of tensors, supporting batching of images.

methods.name: setup_for_distributed
methods.description: Overrides print function to disable printing on non-master processes.

methods.name: is_dist_avail_and_initialized
methods.description: Checks if distributed package is available and initialized.

methods.name: get_world_size
methods.description: Returns the total number of processes in distributed setup.

methods.name: get_rank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the current process.

methods.name: is_main_process
methods.description: Checks if the current process is the main process (rank 0).

methods.name: save_on_master
methods.description: Saves a model or data only if in the main process.

methods.name: init_distributed_mode
methods.description: Initializes distributed training environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: accuracy
methods.description: Computes top-k accuracy metrics for model outputs.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs tensor interpolation with support for empty batches, compatible with torchvision versions.
